text: The pump station on Pier 4 has two pumps and a backup generator.
Flood gates close when the river gauge passes 3.2 metres.
Residents on Water Street are told to move cars to the Mill lot.
The generator is tested on the first Monday of each month.
Sandbags are stored in the depot behind the fire station.
The shelter at Lincoln School holds 200 people.
Alerts go out by text message and by the siren on the town hall.
The bridge on Mill Road is closed when water covers the deck.
Drinking water is tested after every flood.
The recovery office is open from nine to five on weekdays.
Power is cut to the low streets before the gates close.
A damage form is filed with the recovery office within 30 days.
